purpose: Machine-readable semantics separating defect detection from actual prevention enforcement.
rule: A legacy guarded defect is detection-only unless explicit enforcement evidence upgrades it. Prevented requires local, hosted, and merge enforcement and recurrence escalation. A repository ruleset must mechanically require the canonical merge statuses before merge-enforced or prevented may be claimed.

family_lifecycle_semantics.purpose: The legacy defects list records individual historical findings and upgrades them through explicit_enforcement. The families list records machine-enforced recurring-defect families, and a family carries its own stage because the evidence that supports the stage -- applicability, prevention mechanism and boundary, guard reference, regression tests -- is declared on the family itself.
family_lifecycle_semantics.rule: A family may claim a stage only when the evidence it declares supports it: above 'recorded' at least one resolvable regression test, above 'regression-tested' a resolvable machine guard at a machine boundary, and 'prevented' additionally a merge-gate boundary plus an explicit_enforcement entry naming that family as prevented. When a family also appears in explicit_enforcement the two states must agree.

PRH-007.local: .githooks/pre-push -> python scripts/hunter_pre_push.py enforces, before any network mutation, a clean tree, the pushed branch SHA bound to the checked-out exact HEAD, writer provenance over the governed range, connector authorization receipt freshness, governance-evidence path protection, preflight-mode validity, and the deterministic push-safety gates (Architecture Index Guard, Artifact Guard, Defect Prevention Guard, Ruff, Black, Mypy). Issue #415 moved the full repository suite out of this boundary and into the single authoritative hosted exact-head proof, which candidate admission already required; docs/VALIDATION_STAGE_CONTRACT.json is the machine-readable ownership contract.
PRH-007.hosted: Exact-head Hunter / Pre-PR Preflight is the authoritative full repository proof and runs the complete canonical normal preflight on pushed branch heads; the trusted Hunter Governance Review independently rejects a PR head without a successful exact-head branch preflight and verifies main ruleset conformance. CI reuses that proof only for a byte-identical integration tree, keyed to immutable identity and never to a mutable latest-green notion.
PRH-007.merge: Active GitHub ruleset Protect main mechanically requires Quality Gates, dependency-review, CodeQL, Hunter Governance Review, and Hunter Merge Readiness, with no bypass actors
PRH-007.recurrence: Any pushed-head recurrence is a prevention-system failure and requires enforcement-gap correction in docs/REVIEWER_FINDING_DISPOSITIONS.json
